content:
"skill instructions encourage you to click for the printable version, then fill the Sudoku grid using the digits 1 to 9, ensuring each number appears once in every row, column and 3x3 box, while reflecting on the current climate of puzzle publishing.

The temporary gas of excitement builds when you decide to buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the completed puzzle.

A delightful twist lies in the rule that each digit must be unique per row, column and block, challenging your logic.

The weight of solving the grid rests on your ability to place each number correctly, turning a simple exercise into a satisfying mental workout."
